mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher costs and potential Fed tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher costs and potential Fed tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following YoY INDPRO deceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher borrowing costs and potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the HOUST index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in lower consumer spending and potential recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following YoY HOUST deceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment, as measured by the year-over-year change in the PAYEMS index, signals a strengthening labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months following YoY PAYEMS acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, as measured by the year-over-year change in the CPIAUCSL index, signals a high inflation regime that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher costs and potential Fed tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following YoY CPIAUCSL acceleration above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures, as measured by the year-over-year change in the RSAFS index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower consumer spending and potential recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of months following YoY RSAFS deceleration.
